# Buying Wealth
> Book by Dr. Connor Robertson on building wealth through strategic acquisitions.

## About
Buying Wealth by Dr. Connor Robertson provides a comprehensive guide to building wealth through business and real estate acquisitions. The book covers deal sourcing, valuation, financing, and operational strategies for acquiring income-producing assets.
